blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
return query<UserRow>(sql);
findings.recommendation: CWE-89. Any holder of the support role sends `GET /users/search?q=` with a term such as `x' UNION SELECT id, password_hash FROM users --` (the route only checks its length, src/server.ts:13-17) and reads or alters any table the database user can reach. Bind the term as a parameter, as `query` in src/db.ts expects: `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", ["%" + term + "%"])`, and add a test with a term containing a quote.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term

findings.recommendation: Once the term is bound, `%` and `_` in it still act as wildcards, so `q=%%` matches every user instead of names containing `%`. Escape `\`, `%` and `_` in the term before wrapping it in `%…%` (with `ESCAPE '\'`).
findings.title: LIKE wildcards in the term are not escaped
